description: Catalogue registration check (batch ISRC lookup): checks up to 50 recordings at once against The MLC's bulk data (US mechanical royalties), and a larger catalogue in several calls. Returns each recording's verdict (registered, partial, nobody, conflict, unknown) with its confidence, MLC song code and any unclaimed share, plus a summary counting each verdict, the next step for each verdict found, and the as_of date of the MLC snapshot. Each row also lists the ISWCs and writers of the works MusicBrainz links to the recording. Invalid ISRCs are listed and skipped. It finds recordings whose music royalties may be unmatched or unclaimed. Findings from registration data, not legal advice or a statement of song ownership.

isrcs.description: ISRCs, 12 characters, e.g. USIR20400274 (hyphens and spaces allowed). At most 50; split larger catalogues into several calls.

name: check_catalogue

CatalogueItem.description:
One recording's row: the verdict's state and confidence, and the facts
that differ from row to row.

A row carries no evidence and no next step. Most rows with the same state
share them, so the summary gives each next step once (``next_steps``), and
``lookup_recording`` gives one recording's own evidence. Fifty rows that
each carried a full verdict measured about 40 KB on 5 October 2026, most
of it the same sentences: too much for a catalogue of a few hundred.

VerdictState.description:
What the registration data shows for a recording, in one word.

Precedence when several apply: unknown > conflict > nobody > partial >
registered (``app/services/isrc/verdict.py``). Only a snapshot that was
read can produce ``nobody``; an unreadable copy is ``unknown``.
